summary: First full run (backend + Expo web UI at 375x667). Backend: 22/22 pytest pass, covering auth, pincode, upload/download, registrations of all 4 types, the admin approve/reject/delete/stats flow with 403 checks, posts, rules, emergency and complaints. Frontend: every requested flow passed. That covers login/signup, the dashboard title and 9 cards, the More sheet (Complaints opens, other items show a Coming soon toast) and the terms dialogs on 4 cards (decline closes, accept navigates). The member form passed end to end: PIN 411001 auto-fill, Convert to English, Save disabled until the form is complete, submit, Pending in My Submissions, admin approve, then the entry shows in the directory with search and sub-caste chips. Events and Notice tabs, Rules, Emergency, admin Post/Complaints/Settings, photo upload with the 1.0-3.0x zoom slider, matrimony age rules and the GST check also passed. Only low/medium issues found. Deprecated packages detected: none.

minor.issue: No server-side validation of form data. Required fields, phone, email, pincode, GST and the matrimony age (18/21) rules exist only on the client. Confirmed: POST matrimony with dob 01/01/2015 and primary_mobile '123' returned 200.
Any logged-in user can download any uploaded file, including photos of pending or rejected entries. There is no owner, approved-status or admin check.
Uses @app.on_event, which FastAPI has deprecated in favour of lifespan handlers.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Invalid username or password' error stays visible after switching from Sign In to Sign Up. The error is not cleared when the mode changes.
A future DOB (01/01/2030) shows 'Groom must be at least 21 years old' instead of 'Date cannot be in the future', because def.validate overwrites the field error (Object.assign in validateForm).

The rule-based output is awkward for common words: फ्लॅट -> 'Phlet' (expected Flat) and शिवाजी -> 'Shivajee' (expected Shivaji). The requested name गणेश दत्तात्रय सोनार -> 'Ganesh Dattatray Sonar' converts correctly.

issues: The footer only says 'Please fix 1 highlighted field' without naming the field or scrolling to it. On long forms the user has to search for the error.
Opening /register/<type> directly skips the terms dialog that the dashboard enforces.

action_items: Add server-side validation in POST /api/registrations: required title, phone/email/pincode/GST regex, matrimony minimum age by category.
Restrict GET /api/files to the file owner, the admin, or files referenced by approved registrations.
Clear the login error when switching between the Sign In and Sign Up tabs.
In the matrimony validate step, keep the 'Date cannot be in the future' error and skip the age check when the date is in the future.
Optional: improve transliteration for ॅ and final ी (e.g. Shivaji, Flat), and name the invalid field in the footer hint.
critical_code_review_comments: Form validation exists only on the client (forms.ts validateForm), so the API accepts any payload.
Pincode lookups are cached in db.pincodes without a unique index, so concurrent first lookups can insert duplicates (harmless).
No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) are used. No react-native SafeAreaView is used; the app uses safe-area-context insets.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (3 low-severity UI bugs)

seed_data_creation: test_* users created via signup. One approved member 'Ganesh Zq...' and TEST* news/event/notice posts left in the DB from UI tests. Complaints were created and one was resolved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=... && pytest /app/backend/tests/test_sonar_api.py. Names in member forms must be letters only (digits fail the name regex). Web photo upload works via page.expect_file_chooser on photo-<key>. Dropdowns use field-<key> then field-<key>-option-<i>. The Members card opens the directory; directory-register-button opens the terms dialog.
